From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Latency & 5xx spikes since yesterday's model upgrade

Short update from infra and runtime: we did enable v5.2 with an int8 profile on a small percentage of Reserved endpoints overnight as part of the staged rollout. BrightArc was included in that cohort due to their reserved pool configuration. Early signs in the traces:

- Increased decode stalls under concurrent hot-paths (KV cache behavior differs vs v5.1)
- Higher tail latency on our hosting nodes for the int8 kernel path when sequence lengths spike (>512 tokens)
- A small but correlated rise in transient 5xxs tied to a memory-pressure fallback in the runtime (we're seeing GC-like retries)

Action plan (first 60 minutes):
1) Immediately remove BrightArc from the v5.2-int8 cohort and route back to v5.1-fp16 (rollback toggle applied now).
2) Disable aggressive batching on their endpoint to avoid decode stalls while we stabilize.
3) Collect a controlled sample and validate p95 / 5xx trends.
4) If stable, schedule a canary with a conservative quant profile and KV-cache guardrails.

I'll update in 20 minutes with TTST and whether the rollback completes cleanly. Neha will follow on quant-profile tuning.

Rishi
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime
